description: This is a Java class named MappingStrategiesFactory, which functions as a factory class providing access to singleton instances of various MappingStrategies classes related to different command and event mapping in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter module.

classes.name: MappingStrategiesFactory
classes.description: A final utility class that provides static methods to retrieve singleton instances of various mapping strategy classes used within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.

methods.name: getPolicyModifyCommandMappingStrategies
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PolicyModifyCommandMappingStrategies.

methods.name: getPolicyQueryCommandMappingStrategies
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PolicyQueryCommandMappingStrategies.

methods.name: getThingModifyCommandMappingStrategies
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ThingModifyCommandMappingStrategies.

methods.name: getThingQueryCommandMappingStrategies
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ThingQueryCommandMappingStrategies.

methods.name: getThingSearchCommandMappingStrategies
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ThingSearchCommandMappingStrategies.

methods.name: getThingEventMappingStrategies
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ThingEventMappingStrategies.

methods.name: getSubscriptionEventMappingStrategies
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SubscriptionEventMappingStrategies, requires an ErrorRegistry parameter.

methods.name: getMessageCommandMappingStrategies
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessageCommandMappingStrategies.

methods.name: getMessageCommandResponseMappingStrategies
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessageCommandResponseMappingStrategies.
